newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB's Gehrig sees no current monetary tightening.
newsitem.headline: SNB's Gehrig sees no current monetary tightening.

text.p: Swiss National Bank board member Bruno Gehrig said the current situation in the Swiss economy does not require any tightening in monetary policy.
Gehrig also said this is "no time for a hasty braking manoeuvre" in monetary policy.
He added that when tightening were to occur, it is not likely to require drastic braking.
Asked by reporters about his view of the dollar following the Group of Seven (G7) meeting last month in Washington, Gehrig said:
"We are not concerned about the strong dollar."
He added that foreign exchange rates are only one indicator taken into account when the SNB decides on monetary policy.
